newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular unit to make acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular unit to make acquisitions.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said Thursday its wholly owned Universal Commodities Corp subsidiary completed agreements to acquire three computer parts and mainframe suppliers.
Applied said as a result of the targeted transactions, Universal Commodities' earnings contribution has the potential to deliver an estimated $0.05 to per share earnings in 1997.
The acquisitions will support Universal Commodities' ability to service accounts needing a full line of both mainframe and PC product lines.

Companies to be acquired include Norcom Resources Inc, a third-party mainframe and parts maintenance company; Pizzaro Re-Marketing Inc, specializing in remarketing of mainframe computers and disk/tape memory peripheral products, and Forz Corp, a distributor of used computer systems and parts.
All three transactions are expected to close by the end of the 1997 first quarter.
Applied Cellular chairman Richard Sullivan also said the company anticipates continued acquisitions in 1997.
